notablePrerequisites: You have at least one permanent card in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Planewide Celebration by paying {5}{G}{G}, choosing the first mode three times and the third mode once.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {1}.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Planewide Celebration.
Resolve the Planewide Celebration copy, creating three 2/2 Citizen creature tokens and returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the Citizens, adding {1}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
